authority: Game owner requested an explicit Pass control to finish the active player ordinary turn early; acceptance is recorded in issue #85.

decisions.decision: Only the active non-eliminated player may explicitly pass their ordinary speaking turn. Injured and jailed players retain this right. Authorization requires the current ordinary phase and trusted startedAt <= now < endsAt.

Passing closes only the ordinary turn. A previously requested Hack opens its normal separate 60-second conversation; otherwise the recorded turn order advances to the next living seat or the normal post-turn release/vote phase.
Registered main actions and shots keep their resource reservations, recorded targets and canonical resolution timing. Passing neither cancels them nor triggers early round resolution.
Hack, Captain election/runoff, release choice/vote, Jail vote and showdown cannot be passed or closed early by this command. All their existing timing and audience rules remain.
Pass is a strict targetless protocol-2 command through the normal authenticated receipt path. The current player capability is legalTargets.PASS_TURN = [self seat ID]; it grants no client authority.
Passing is explicit player intent. Practice bots do not automatically pass and retain their existing pace.

version_policy: Newly created matches pin this gameplay version at creation. Controls without gameplay pins, already prepared legacy deals and running legacy matches retain the exact deployed full-game-1.0.1 parent tuple without Pass. Recorded setup versions determine launch and replay; no existing pin is rewritten.
unchanged: Role/Code/turn randomization, random starting-room assignment, 30-second character stage, 30-second reading minimum plus every human Ready, movement, defenses, round resolution, victory and audience disclosure.
